def run_compile_options(control):
    need(R["sql_execute_calls"] == 0, "Compile options must be the first SQL call")
    need(time.monotonic() - SQL_START < 5, "SQL interval before compile metadata")
    sql = control["literal_sql"]
    entry = {"index": 0, "phase": "receiver-metadata", "id": "compile_options",
             "literal_sql": sql, "started_seconds": time.monotonic() - START,
             "execute_returned": False, "cursor_closed": False, "completed": False,
             "retained_one_column_string_rows": [], "capture_truncated": False}
    R["sql_calls"].append(entry)
    R["sql_execute_calls"] += 1
    cursor = DB.cursor()
    before_changes = DB.total_changes
    entry["total_changes_before"] = before_changes
    try:
        cursor.execute(sql)
        entry["execute_returned"] = True
        entry["columns"] = [x[0] for x in cursor.description] if cursor.description else []
        need(entry["columns"] == control["columns"], "Compile metadata column differs")
        rows = cursor.fetchmany(257)
        entry["row_count_observed_including_overflow_sentinel"] = len(rows)
        entry["end_of_rows_observed"] = len(rows) < 257
        total_bytes = 0
        for row in rows[:256]:
            if len(row) != 1 or type(row[0]) is not str:
                entry["invalid_row_preview"] = [typed_value(v) for v in row[:16]]
                raise RuntimeError("Compile metadata must be one-column string rows")
            size = len(row[0].encode("utf-8"))
            if size > 512 or total_bytes + size > 16384:
                entry["capture_truncated"] = True
                entry["next_row_utf8_bytes"] = size
                entry["next_row_prefix"] = row[0][:128]
                raise RuntimeError("Compile metadata string/capture cap")
            total_bytes += size
            entry["retained_one_column_string_rows"].append([row[0]])
        entry["retained_value_utf8_bytes"] = total_bytes
        need(entry["end_of_rows_observed"], "Compile metadata exceeds256 retained rows")
        options = [row[0] for row in rows]
        temp_options = [value for value in options if value.startswith("TEMP_STORE")]
        entry["literal_temp_store_entries"] = temp_options
        need(len(temp_options) == 1 and temp_options[0] in
             ("TEMP_STORE=1", "TEMP_STORE=2", "TEMP_STORE=3"),
             "Compile-time TEMP_STORE absent, ambiguous or outside1/2/3")
        entry["total_changes_after"] = DB.total_changes
        entry["in_transaction_after"] = DB.in_transaction
        need(DB.total_changes == before_changes == 0 and DB.in_transaction is False,
             "Compile metadata changed the fresh memory database")
        R["admitted_compile_temp_store"] = temp_options[0]
        entry["completed"] = True
    finally:
        cursor.close()
        entry["cursor_closed"] = True
        entry["elapsed_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - START - entry["started_seconds"]
